rationale: Placed after the burden section to test recall of key WHO PHEIC declarations — foundational factual knowledge needed before analysing determinants.
Placed after the determinants section to test understanding of One Health as a structural driver of outbreak emergence — a key concept in the syllabus.
Placed after the evaluation section to test analytical use of epidemic metrics (Rt) in outbreak assessment — directly supported by the clinical pearl at block 9.
Placed after the key-laws section to test factual recall of a major legislative change — the NMC Act 2020 replacing the MCI — which directly affects community physicians.
Placed after the applied-practice section to test application of the MTP Amendment 2021 in a real PHC scenario — the hook features Dr Priya facing exactly this dilemma.
